_readme: Effective-dated statutory and exchange charge schedule for NSE.
Each list is sorted by `from` (inclusive). A lookup for trade date D uses the last entry with from <= D.
Rates are fractions of turnover unless stated (0.001 = 0.1%). For options, turnover = premium turnover.
Backtests dated before `coverage_from` are refused unless the run sets allow_rule_extrapolation=true,
in which case the earliest entry is used and the report is flagged.
Entries marked verified=false were written from memory and MUST be checked against the cited
circular before they are relied upon. See docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

stt._note: Securities Transaction Tax. delivery: both sides. intraday/futures/options: sell side only. exercise: buyer of an ITM option, on intrinsic value.

schedule.source: Finance Act 2016 rates in force (rates unverified). Exercise STT was levied on the full settlement value until 2019-08-31
Finance (No.2) Act 2019: exercise STT on intrinsic value from 2019-09-01 (base verified via NSE STT page and broker bulletins; the unchanged rates carried from the previous row are unverified)
Finance Act 2026 (Union Budget 2026-27); press coverage checked 2026-11
NSE schedule before 2024-04-01 (slab-based; lowest-turnover slab used)

sebi_fee._note: SEBI turnover fee, both sides. 0.000001 = Rs 10 per crore.

schedule.source: Rs 10/crore; SEBI changed this fee several times in 2019-2021 (Rs 15 -> 5 -> 10 per crore). Not modelled; impact is < 0.0001% of turnover.

stamp_duty._note: Buy side only. Uniform national rates since 2020-07-01. Earlier duty was state-specific and is modelled as zero (flagged).

gst._note: On brokerage + exchange transaction charges + SEBI fee.
